title: Classify all three-relation words on the four-projector maximizer
body:
**Scoped negative result: every finite word on the four-projector maximizer with at most three saturated exponent relations has only two productive diagonal targets.** For all four types present, nonzero paid labels, a torsion-free paid-generated exponent group and the original four-coordinate diagonal boundary, the endpoint is `diag([u],[u],1,1)`. The complete rank-power tariff cannot improve for `0<t<=1`. **No new kappa** follows.

Read the [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/030ecb77c63a4bcc0fb5286cee9e42e856975da3/research/one-edge-word-obstruction/PROOF.md), [order certificates](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/030ecb77c63a4bcc0fb5286cee9e42e856975da3/research/one-edge-word-obstruction/RESULT.json), [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/030ecb77c63a4bcc0fb5286cee9e42e856975da3/research/one-edge-word-obstruction/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/030ecb77c63a4bcc0fb5286cee9e42e856975da3/research/one-edge-word-obstruction/SOURCE-PINS.json) and [credits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/030ecb77c63a4bcc0fb5286cee9e42e856975da3/research/one-edge-word-obstruction/CREDITS.md). This resolves the minimal-relation word question for the alphabet in [PR #7749](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7749).

The proof gives necessary and sufficient conditions. No P or Q can lie between the first and last R calls. No Q can lie between the first and last S calls. After deleting P/Q, the R/S word has at most three runs. Exact totals must satisfy P=Q=u and R=S=0. A private-writer lemma first proves that R and S each need two calls, so six calls are the sharp minimum. Three independent first-order patterns and four independent commutators force the chronology at every length. Exact private-row identities then force cancellation; parity alone is insufficient.

All 35 multiplicity domains through nine calls agree under two separate enumeration methods: 108,904 type orders, with exact quadratic and full Laurent checks. Exactly 8,412 endpoints are diagonal, all with the predicted entries. A separate multivariate engine checks 175 products. Four hundred conjugated single-writer controls and three even-total faults pass. The source geometry verifier runs unchanged. The finite domains support the written all-length proof; they do not enumerate all saturated lattices.

Python 3.12, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/one-edge-word-obstruction
```

Both registered commands print:

```text
PASS_ONE_EDGE_WORD_OBSTRUCTION
35 multiplicity domains; 108904 type orders; exact degree-two and full Laurent checks
8412 diagonal endpoints; 175 independent sparse products; 400 unique-writer controls
All-length three-relation classification: exact R/S cancellation and endpoint diag([u],[u],1,1)
```

Normal and optimized registered replay, syntax/indentation, committed bytes/source history/modes, export and sealed read-only Git-free serial replay pass. Hosted CI did not certify this package. The [plan job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44435308240/job/135262564731) failed in the shared `test_current_ci_section_matches_selected_record`: the base guide names frontier6030 while the selected record requires `make frontier7000-verify`. The log reports 760 tests, one failure and 24 skipped; package replay was skipped. This package changes no shared CI file. Local replay remains the scientific evidence.

Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the [alphabet and question](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6bd8a384d64b6da2334bc94f6a97cdd74d710780/research/even-one-edge-maximizer/README.md) and [unchanged geometry checker](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6bd8a384d64b6da2334bc94f6a97cdd74d710780/research/even-one-edge-maximizer/verify.py). His notices credit Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, for the comparison pool in [PR #7707](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7707) and matching theorem in [PR #7692](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7692). The augmentation approach follows the [retained proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ac185e4529a01156f7b574555b50827f8cb645bb/research/shared-hub-triple-word-obstruction/PROOF.md) in [PR #7711](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7711), which credits Jerry Jiaheng Chen (@CubeJerry) and [PR #6782](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6782). The finite engines adapt [PR #7763](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7763), with its [checker](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/verify.py) and [credit chain](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3cb09504f8c1b6b728d8ce90b76ff938c06fbe5d/research/shared-hub-seven-call/CREDITS.md) retained byte-exact.

More than three relations, changed projector pools or coordinate boundaries, native realization, physical storage/restoration and the complete caller invoice remain open. The full PR7711/PR7763 word suites, other geometry suites, selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. All five framework assumptions and the selected frontier remain unchanged. No global literature priority or independent human/formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.
